armorSamplingContract.requestedSpins: The committed armor-count result N requires exactly N actual armor-piece spins.
armorSamplingContract.scope: One Dwarf armor-award event, identified by runId, event invocation, and component slot when applicable.
armorSamplingContract.beforeEachDraw: Remove all chosen armor IDs from the eligible set, apply declared guards to remaining pieces, normalize remaining weights, and freeze this draw distribution.
armorSamplingContract.commit: Atomically journal the result, append the chosen ID, grant its armor instance and one +1 numeric modifier, update remaining IDs, append context, then react.
armorSamplingContract.repeatKey: Every scheduled draw has its own stable invocation ID and ordinal; do not share one consumed-event key across repeated draws.
armorSamplingContract.duplicatePolicy: Chosen pieces always have effective weight zero. Weight modifiers cannot restore their eligibility. Never reroll a committed duplicate or substitute another result.
armorSamplingContract.wheelRendering: Chosen sections are disabled and have zero sector angle in subsequent active wheels. Redistribute the active circle using remaining frozen probabilities; show collected pieces outside the active wheel if desired.
armorSamplingContract.lastDrawPolicy: If N=5, the fifth scheduled piece spin still occurs with the sole remaining piece at 100%, then receives its own result/reaction. This is an explicit exception to the generic fixed-identity reveal shortcut.

armorSamplingContract.poolExhaustion: Configuration error if requested remaining draws exceed eligible remaining unique pieces; do not truncate the awarded count or silently reuse a piece.
armorSamplingContract.bonusUnits: Numeric points, following the established +1-point convention; numeric scales or explicit mappings required.
armorSamplingContract.additionalStats: No unrequested material, quality, weight, durability, intelligence, or mobility effects are inferred.
